english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the trio consists of people, including three musicians when no technical musical term is needed.

examples.english: Those three are always together; they’re really the office trio.
examples.traditional: 嗰三個人成日黐埋一齊，真係公司入面嘅三人組。
